description: Choose whether players (and their data/leaderboards) are shared across all of your games ('account', the default) or isolated to one game ('project'). Set this ONCE at setup: it locks as soon as the game has any players, because changing it would split existing players and their leaderboards across two scopes. To use a different scoping, create a new game. IRREVERSIBLE: always name the target with `game`; this tool refuses to pick when the studio has several.

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

name: set_player_scope
title: Set how players are scoped
